Components / Surfaces

Price above the action

.dr-price · __lbl · __val · components/rows.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Selected · Wed 2 Jul, 09:00₴800
Confirm slot
  1. 1.dr-priceThe line: display:flex, align-items: baseline, space-between, gap 12. It sits on the action bar's shelf above the button.
  2. 2.dr-price__lblWhat the price is for, 13/400 in --text-muted, 6.62:1 on the action bar's --bg-page.
  3. 3.dr-price__valThe price, 17/600 in --text-primary, tabular, 15.99:1 on --bg-page.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Price line.

States

No state of its own: the line is read, never pressed. The button under it takes the button states.

When to use

The price line puts the sum on the button's own shelf, so the price and the commitment are read in one glance. It stands on one screen in 4 files: time-slot, time-slot-empty, time-slot-inspection and time-slot-inspection-empty, where it is the only place the price is stated at all. Every other screen states its price in a money rows breakdown and in the CTA's verb.

This is voice.md P3 built as a component: state the price as a fact, before the tap. Baseline, not centre: align-items: baseline sets the 13px label and 17px value on one line of type. The value is tabular-nums, so a price does not jitter as it changes. Both pairs clear WCAG 1.4.3's 4.5:1, and the money is the one that reads first.

The label names what is being paid for, as a fact (Selected · Wed 2 Jul, 09:00); the value is the full price with no from and no asterisk.

Sources: ui/kit.html Price above the action · voice.md P3 · inventory.md § 1.6 (Price line, Total)

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Selected · Wed 2 Jul, 09:00₴800
Confirm slot

A choice whose price is otherwise nowhere on the screen: the line stands directly above the button that commits to it.

Don’t

Total₴180
Pay ₴180

A Total line above a CTA that already says the sum, on a screen that already shows the breakdown: the fact is stated three times. The action-bar Total line came off every screen; the total lives in money rows and in the button's verb.
